gloss: to start up; to get moving; to launch

definitions.gloss: to start up; to begin operating
definitions.explanation: To begin operation, especially of an engine, machine, or system. Also used for projects, plans, and organizations beginning their work.

examples.japanese: エンジンが{始動|しどう}した。
{新|あたら}しいプロジェクトがいよいよ{始動|しどう}する。
examples.english: The new project is finally launching.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}い{朝|あさ}はバッテリーが{弱|よわ}くて、{車|くるま}がなかなか{始動|しどう}しない。
examples.english: On cold mornings the battery is weak and the car won't start easily.

notes:
Means to start operating or get moving. Used for both machines/engines and figurative 'launches' of projects and initiatives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- エンジンが{始動|しどう}する — the engine starts
- エンジンを{始動|しどう}させる — to start the engine
- プロジェクトが{始動|しどう}する — a project launches
- {本格的|ほんかくてき}に{始動|しどう}する — to get fully underway
- {始動|しどう}が{遅|おく}れる — the start is delayed

RELATED TERMS:
- {起動|きどう}する — to boot up, start (especially computers/systems)
- {発動|はつどう}する — to invoke, activate (laws, powers)
- {始|はじ}まる — to begin (general, everyday)
- {開始|かいし}する — to commence (formal)

USAGE NOTE:
{始動|しどう} is more concrete and dynamic than {開始|かいし}. It evokes the image of an engine turning over — the physical start of something. {開始|かいし} is more neutral and administrative.
